Product Engineer, EL/SW Testing

John Deere is hiring an entry-level Product Engineer for its Turf & Compact Utility Engineering team. The role develops and executes software tests for vehicle electrical systems, collaborates on system and component validation, and supports test automation and modeling tools.
Agriculture
Construction
Manufacturing
AgTech
Industrial Manufacturing
Machinery Manufacturing
Comp. & Benefits
No H1B
Responsibilities
Utilize your combined electronics, controls, & embedded software testing skills as a core member of the team delivering world-class customer-delighting features for our products
Apply engineering rigor in the development & execution of software test plans & procedures for vehicle electrical systems per a defined development process & software testing principles
Collaborate with testers, developers, & stakeholders to validate key system & component features while representing the needs of our customers and our dealer network
Embrace and innovate tools for requirements, test plans, test procedures, test execution, & test reporting and regularly communicate status to stakeholders
Support modeling/simulation/virtualization ecosystem development activities to continually enhance test coverage and test automation
Qualification
Embedded Software Testing
Electrical/Electronic Schematics
Software Requirements
SAE J1939 CAN Protocol
CANape
CANalyzer
Model-in-the-Loop (MiL) Testing
Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) Testing
Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) Testing
Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL) Testing
Automotive and Off-Highway Vehicle Component Validation
Required
Experience in Electrical and/or Software Engineering performing analysis, design & testing of embedded software
Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamworking skills with those inside and outside your department
Experience reviewing and interpreting vehicle-level & component-level electrical/electronic schematics and software requirements
Experience with (or the ability to quickly master) SAE J1939 CAN analysis tools, e.g. CANape or CANalyzer, for debugging J1939 CAN protocol on a complex vehicle network
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited institution, or equivalent degree/experience in a related technology field or discipline
Must be 18 years of age or older to apply
VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position
Preferred
Experience in embedded systems testing in one or multiple levels: Model-in-the-Loop (MiL), Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL)and Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL)
Electrical/electronic/electro-mechanical/mechatronic component development and/or validation experience for automotive or off-highway vehicle applications
Fundamental understanding and experience operating mobile equipment (particularly agricultural and/or outdoor power equipment)

Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account
